english.title: Use on a road a coach / bus when the speed limiter was not sealed / maintained in good order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a

(A)_[coach,]_
(B)_[bus,]_

fitted with a speed limiter that was not

(C)_[sealed by an authorised sealer in such a manner as to protect the limiter against improper interference or adjustment and against interference with its power supply]_
(D)_[maintained in good and efficient working order]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 36A(5) and (9) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
